citation: Conte, M., P. Cotterlaz and T. Mayer (2022), The CEPII Gravity database, CEPII Working Paper No. 2022-05.
rta_source: WTO Regional Trade Agreements Information System (as incorporated by CEPII Gravity V202211)
rta_time_rule: CEPII documentation: a pair is considered in an RTA in a given year if the RTA was in force before July 1; RTA variables are zero for origin=destination.
source_note: Gravity_V202211.dta is used directly for 2007-2021. No 2021 extension or carry-forward is performed.
